action: General advice: patients should book through the channels the hospital announces while its systems are restored; health providers should keep offline backups and a plan for running appointments without digital systems.
date_note: El Dínamo (16 November) relays the hospital statement that the incident was detected on the morning of Saturday 14 November; the record earlier used 16 November, the day Emol said management reported it.
exec: A hospital's online and phone booking channels were interrupted by a cybersecurity incident, and a deputy is asking authorities whether patient records were exposed.
impact: Part of the institutional systems and the web and phone booking channels were interrupted; clinical care continued, according to the hospital.
plain: The University of Chile's Hospital Clínico in Santiago said a cybersecurity incident hit part of its systems, so appointments could not be booked online or by phone. It said care continued. A deputy has asked authorities whether patient records were exposed.
summary: The Hospital Clínico of the Universidad de Chile said a cybersecurity incident detected on the morning of Saturday 14 November interrupted part of its institutional systems, including web and phone booking (El Dínamo). It said clinical care continued and it is working with ANCI, Chile’s cybersecurity agency. Deputy Lilian Betancurt filed five oversight requests, one on a possible breach of clinical records (Emol); neither article says whether data was accessed.
title: Chile's Hospital Clínico de la Universidad de Chile reports cybersecurity incident; booking channels down

validation.note: El Dínamo and Emol each report the hospital's own statement on the incident; the statement itself was not read directly. Neither says whether data was accessed.

review.note: stronger than the source: 'Deputies filed five oversight requests' was one deputy (Lilian Betancurt, Emol) filing five oficios; summary, plain and exec now say a deputy and a possible breach, not confirmed. Date, ANCI, booking channels, care continuing checked against El Dínamo and Emol.
